newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BRL Hardy buys 50 pct stake in vineyard.
newsitem.headline: BRL Hardy buys 50 pct stake in vineyard.

text.p: Australia's second largest wine producer, BRL Hardy Ltd, has bought a 50 percent joint venture interest in the Brookland Valley Vineyard in Western Australia, the parties said in a joint statement on Monday.
A BRL Hardy's spokesman declined to give any financial details of the deal, but said the vineyard was expected to produce around 400 tonnes of premium grapes this year.
The Brookland Valley property has about 20 hectares planted with vines, and is one of the larger vineyeards in the Margaret River region 350 km south of Perth.

"The joint venture will provide Brookland Valley with the opportunity to increase access to Australian and international markets through BRL Hardy's highly successful sales and marketing team," the statement said.
"BRL Hardy is keen to expand the group's involvement in quality vineyards and its focus on premium wines," it said.
Malcolm Jones, manager and part owner of Brookland Valley, will become chief executive officer of the new joint venture.
